title: mimi-mls: Member lifetime policy on join
description: Member::join_welcome uses OpenMLS's default lifetime Verify policy, so joining a group with any member whose leaf outlived its KeyPackage lifetime fails. RFC 9420 §7.3 makes this check RECOMMENDED for received leaves. Needs a decision (members may differ from the Observer decision mimid-1wgh.4.38) and use of OpenMLS's Welcome JoinBuilder skip option. Found during .4.6.
notes:
Decided: mimid-1wgh.4.56 (skip on received leaves). Implement: Member join_welcome/join_external/process use LeafNodeLifetimePolicy::Skip where OpenMLS allows (JoinBuilder skip_lifetime_validation; processing path may need the fork's policy hooks — stop and ask if a fork change is needed).
2026-10-17: OpenMLS MlsGroup has no way to set the stored lifetime policy (only PublicGroup does; resets to Verify on join/load). Mark approved a fork write: MlsGroup::set_leaf_node_lifetime_policy pass-through + regression test, commit and plain push to MarkAtwood/openmls mimid-0.9.1; mimid rev bump in the .4.40 worktree.
